method: Chromium software WebGL 2 and Canvas; emulated viewports, real UI actions plus labelled deterministic stepping

cases.name: canvas-1280x800
checks: nonblank intended page, requested backend and reachable new tools
preview is isolated and silent, favourites persist, Select and Launch remain distinct
three-cue edits, undo/redo, save, rename, recipe export, bounded import rejection and share link
same-clock personal playback, dialog pause, full residue completion and deliberate Encore
actual scene PNG preview, truthful dimensions and decodable download
short scene-only clip records, stops, releases and decodes real nonblack frames
recipient must review then choose Play; link never autoplays or unmutes; favourites persist
